decisions.reason: Follow-up confirmation from ATF: breach limited to a standalone system with investigation target info. Significant detail update on the Qilin ransomware claim story.

Second emergency patch with CVE IDs (CVE-2026-82078, CVE-2026-81578) for actively exploited flaws. Chained auth bypass + code execution on PaperCut NG/MF versions 25-26. Belongs in the existing PaperCut zero-day story.

CVE-2026-81578.evidence: PaperCut confirmed active zero-day exploitation against customer servers; second patch released after researchers found bypass methods for initial fix.

CVE-2026-82078.evidence: Chained with CVE-2026-81578 for authentication bypass and code execution; confirmed actively exploited in the wild against PaperCut NG/MF.
